page.notes: Printed "Ethacratione" is run together in the scan; read as "Et hac ratione". "em" (enim) has an unclear abbreviation mark. "Epidimiōn" has a superscript mark over the n, read as a macron. The printed text runs on from "in-" to the catchword "fitum"; the catchword is kept as printed. The four quotation marks in the right margin stand beside the lines "corpus,caloru", "culum", "ftrumetum" and "Errat"; they are reproduced as printed.
